id.description: NeTEx ID of the sales package.

versionNumber.description: The version number. Only present for published versions.

ownerOrganisationId.description: The ID of the organization that owns the sales package.

allOf.description: Status of this sales package version.

fareProducts.description: List of fare product references included in this sales package.

validFrom.description: Start of the validity period (travel dates, not version date).

validTo.description: End of the validity period. No specified date means that the validity period has no end-date.

publishedDate.description: System-assigned timestamp of when the version was published. Only present for VERSIONED status.

fareProductId.description: NeTEx ID of the fare product.

fareProductVersionId.description: NeTEx version ID of the fare product.

fareProductVersionNumber.description: Sequence number of the fare product version. Optional — set at publication.

FareProductRef.description: Reference to a specific version of a fare product (e.g. SupplementProduct, PreassignedFareProduct).

value.description: The localized string value for the specified lang.
